name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: (cd scripts/ci && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v) && python3 scripts/ci/check_evidence_format.py && python3 scripts/ci/check_attest_pins.py && python3 scripts/ci/check_report_inputs.py && python3 scripts/ci/check_ci_yml_binding.py && python3 scripts/ci/check_readme_enumeration.py && signoff/check-item6-digital.sh && signoff/check-pvt-grid.sh && sim/lib/test_pdk_env.sh && signoff/test-klt.sh && python3 -I sim/lib/test_bench_record.py && python3 -I sim/program-select/test_summarize.py && python3 -I sim/sense-margin/test_summarize.py && echo 'check:ci OK -- hermetic checks only: checker self-tests, evidence format, attestation pin, report input hashes, ci.yml step binding, README enumeration binding, item 6 spec binding, PVT grid binding, pdk_env self-test, klt helper self-test, bench_record load_reports self-test, program-select and sense-margin summarize self-tests. This does NOT run the CI steps that need an EDA tool, the PDK or a diff base (verification/run.sh, rtl/synth.sh, the klt signoff steps, check_sim_append_only.py), so a green check:ci is not a prediction that CI will pass.'
